# coreJSON

Vendored, unmodified coreJSON v3.3.0 from:
https://github.com/FreeRTOS/coreJSON/tree/v3.3.0/source

Files: core_json.c and include/core_json.h (stored together here).
License: MIT, preserved in both source file headers.

Used for allocation-free JSON validation and top-level response field iteration.
No FreeRTOS dependency is required.
